summary: Patria Investments filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and presentation (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K). The registrant reported Q3 2026 IFRS net income attributable to Patria of $7.2 million, Fee Related Earnings of $52.8 million (up 7% year over year, 53.7% margin), and Distributable Earnings of $46.9 million, or $0.30 per share. It declared a quarterly dividend of $0.1625 per share to holders of record November 13, 2026, payable December 11, 2026. No special-situation transaction; no deal terms. Watch fundraising and FRE trajectory.
